cues.en: At this point, through this section, you have seen how complicated derivatives of multivariable functions can get.
cues.zh: 到本節目前為止，你已經看見，多變數函數的導數，能變得多麼複雜。

cues.en: Not the calculus itself.
cues.zh: 不是微積分本身。

cues.en: That's not much more complicated than for single variable functions.
cues.zh: 那與單變數函數相比，並沒有複雜太多。

cues.en: I'm referring to the difficulty of keeping track of all of the partial derivatives.
cues.zh: 我指的是，要追蹤所有偏導數的困難。

cues.en: Furthermore, we spend a lot of time visualizing derivatives of single variable functions, but I haven't yet mentioned how we can really visualize the gradients.
cues.zh: 此外，我們花了很多時間，把單變數函數的導數視覺化，但還沒有說明，如何真正以精簡方式，呈現梯度，

cues.en: All of the derivatives of two D functions in a compact way.
cues.zh: 也就是二維函數的所有導數。

cues.en: So how do we visualize all of the partial derivatives?
cues.zh: 所以，如何視覺化所有偏導數？

cues.en: Well, I'm going to address all of these issues in this video by introducing you to a gradients fancy
cues.zh: 這支影片會介紹梯度，解決這些問題。名稱很華麗，

cues.en: term, but basically a gradient is just an organized collection of partial derivatives.
cues.zh: 但基本上，梯度只是有組織的一組偏導數。

cues.en: So imagine we have some function of two variables, and here are the partial derivatives.
cues.zh: 假設有某個二變數函數，這裡是它的偏導數。

cues.en: Now, it doesn't actually matter what the function is or what the derivatives are.
cues.zh: 函數究竟是什麼，導數是多少，其實不重要。

cues.en: We don't need to get distracted by the specifics of one example.
cues.zh: 不必被某個例子的細節分心。

cues.en: The point is that a two variable function has two partial derivatives.
cues.zh: 重點是，二變數函數有兩個偏導數。

cues.en: Now, so far we have been considering these two partial derivatives as two completely separate objects.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，我們把它們視為兩個完全分開的物件。

cues.en: You know, you could write down each of these on two separate pieces of paper.
cues.zh: 可以各寫在兩張不同的紙上。

cues.en: You can mail this one to your mom and this one to Elvis Presley if you can find his address.
cues.zh: 一張寄給媽媽，一張寄給貓王，如果找得到他的地址。

cues.en: Anyway, the purpose of the gradient is to bring these partial derivatives together into one mathematical
cues.zh: 總之，梯度的目的，是把這些偏導數集合成同一個數學

cues.en: object, and that is called a vector.
cues.zh: 物件，叫作向量。

cues.en: So here is what the gradient looks like.
cues.zh: 梯度看起來就是這樣。

cues.en: The brackets here indicate a vector where each element in the vector corresponds to the partial derivative with respect to each variable.
cues.zh: 方括號表示向量，其中每個元素，分別對應對各變數的偏導數。

cues.en: So two separate mathematical objects, one mathematical object.
cues.zh: 兩個分開的數學物件，變成一個數學物件。

cues.en: Of course, the information is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 當然，資訊完全相同。

cues.en: This is just a more compact way of organizing that information.
cues.zh: 只是用更精簡的方式，整理資訊。

cues.en: Now, this upside down triangle here is the notation for a gradient.
cues.zh: 這個倒三角形，是梯度的符號。

cues.en: The symbol itself is called a NABA, and it's pronounced as del.
cues.zh: 符號本身叫作 nabla，讀作 del。

cues.en: So you would read this out loud as del F or the gradient of F or grad F.
cues.zh: 所以會念成 del f，或者 f 的梯度，也可以念 grad f。

cues.en: Pretty straightforward, right?
cues.zh: 相當直接，對吧？

cues.en: Exactly.
cues.zh: 沒錯。

cues.en: Let me say a few things about interpreting the gradient of a multivariable function.
cues.zh: 關於如何解讀多變數函數的梯度，我想說幾件事。

cues.en: As I mentioned, the gradient is really just a compact way of organizing the individual partial derivatives.
cues.zh: 正如提過，梯度只是精簡整理個別偏導數的方式。

cues.en: You know, it's like, like when you go traveling somewhere instead of carrying all of your clothes separately, you put them all into a suitcase.
cues.zh: 就像旅行時，不把所有衣服分開拿，而是全部放進行李箱。

cues.en: So then you have only one thing to carry.
cues.zh: 這樣只需要拿一樣東西。

cues.en: And that one thing your suitcase contains all of the individual things that you will need.
cues.zh: 那樣東西，也就是行李箱，包含需要的所有個別物品。

cues.en: But there's more to it than that.
cues.zh: 但還不只如此。

cues.en: There's also computational advantages of gradients because vectors have many important properties in linear algebra.
cues.zh: 梯度也有計算優勢，因為向量在線性代數裡，有許多重要性質。

cues.en: So storing the derivatives as a vector forms a bridge between calculus and matrix analysis.
cues.zh: 所以，把導數儲存為向量，就在微積分與矩陣分析之間搭起橋樑。

cues.en: This is really useful in linear algebra and differential equations and so on.
cues.zh: 在線性代數、微分方程式等等，非常有用。

cues.en: There are also ways of combining partial derivatives in a vector into what's called directional derivatives.
cues.zh: 也能把向量裡的偏導數結合成所謂的方向導數。

cues.en: So derivatives along combinations of variables and geometrically the gradient basically just points uphill.
cues.zh: 也就是沿變數組合方向的導數。幾何上，梯度基本上就是指向上坡。

cues.en: This is the multivariate equivalent of visualizing the derivative of a single variable function as a line plot.
cues.zh: 這是單變數函數導數折線圖，在多變數情況的對應。

cues.en: So you know that the derivative of a single variable function tells you whether the function is going
cues.zh: 單變數函數的導數，告訴你函數在每一點，

cues.en: up or down at each point, and also how steeply it's going up or going down.
cues.zh: 是上升還是下降，以及上升或下降有多陡。

cues.en: Exactly the same concept here with gradients, but we need to expand this from a line to a surface over a plane.
cues.zh: 梯度也是相同概念，只是從線，延伸成平面上的曲面。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So I'm not going to explain this geometric interpretation in more detail, including saying what I mean by local landscape here.
cues.zh: 現在要更詳細解釋幾何意義，包括這裡所說的局部地形是什麼。

cues.en: Okay, so here we have a function and the output of the function is visualized on this grid.
cues.zh: 這裡有個函數，輸出在這個網格上視覺化。

cues.en: And you also see it's two partial derivatives.
cues.zh: 也看得到它的兩個偏導數。

cues.en: Now, nothing new here.
cues.zh: 沒有新東西。

cues.en: You've already seen these kinds of images before.
cues.zh: 這類影像，之前已經看過。

cues.en: The idea is that the numerical value in each block, so each grid coordinate is the partial derivative.
cues.zh: 想法是，每一格、每個網格座標裡的數值，就是偏導數。

cues.en: And these partial derivatives tell you how the function is changing over the x axis and over the Y axis.
cues.zh: 這些偏導數告訴你，函數沿 x 軸與 y 軸，如何改變。

cues.en: Now, what does this mean exactly?
cues.zh: 確切是什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, it means, for example, that at this point here, the function is increasing on the x axis.
cues.zh: 例如，這裡這一點，函數沿 x 軸遞增。

cues.en: So for this value of Y, the function is increasing over x.
cues.zh: 所以，固定這個 y 值，函數沿 x 遞增。

cues.en: Now that's obvious when you look at the function at that point, the function when you go on the x axis, the function is more negative and then it goes to being more positive.
cues.zh: 看函數就很明顯，在那裡，沿 x 軸移動，函數從比較負，變得比較正。

cues.en: So the function is going up along the x direction and that's why the derivative here, the partial derivative is positive.
cues.zh: 所以，函數沿 x 方向上升，這裡的偏導數才會為正。

cues.en: And here this block over here, for example, is blue.
cues.zh: 而這裡，例如這一格，是藍色。

cues.en: That means that the function is going down along the x direction at this point.
cues.zh: 表示函數在這一點，沿 x 方向下降。

cues.en: So at this location for the Y independent variable and the x independent variable along the x direction, the function is going down.
cues.zh: 所以，固定這個 y 與 x 的位置，函數沿 x 方向下降。

cues.en: That's consistent with what you see over here in the function.
cues.zh: 與這裡原函數看到的一致。

cues.en: So the function is getting more and more negative, so more blue corresponding to more negative values as we fix at this y axis value and move along the x axis.
cues.zh: 當我們固定這個 y 軸數值，沿 x 軸移動，函數越來越負，也就是越來越藍，對應更負的值。

cues.en: So that's for partial X.
cues.zh: 這是對 x 的偏導數。

cues.en: Now we can look at partial Y.
cues.zh: 接著看對 y 的偏導數。

cues.en: You can see here, for example, it goes blue to yellow because here in the function it's going negative and then it starts going more positive.
cues.zh: 例如，這裡從藍色變黃色，因為原函數先變負，之後開始變得更正。

cues.en: So somewhere around here, the function, the values are still negative, but it switches its behavior from becoming more negative here, is becoming more positive.
cues.zh: 這附近，函數值仍為負，但行為從越來越負，轉成越來越正。

cues.en: So the function is increasing along the y axis for this particular value of X, and that's why you see the partial derivative with respect to Y is negative and then it's positive.
cues.zh: 所以，固定這個特定 x 值時，函數沿 y 軸開始遞增，因此對 y 的偏導數，先負，後正。

cues.en: Same story over here, but for the opposite sign.
cues.zh: 這裡情況相同，但正負相反。

cues.en: So we're getting more and more positive.
cues.zh: 先越來越正。

cues.en: The function is increasing and here the function is decreasing along the y axis, so the derivative becomes negative.
cues.zh: 函數先遞增，這裡則沿 y 軸遞減，所以導數變負。

cues.en: Okay, I'm still just setting things up here.
cues.zh: 好，仍然只是鋪陳。

cues.en: There's no gradients in this slide.
cues.zh: 這張投影片還沒有梯度。

cues.en: Now I'm going to show an overlay on top of these partial derivatives images.
cues.zh: 現在，要在這些偏導數影像上，加上一層標示。

cues.en: Still no gradients yet.
cues.zh: 還不是梯度。

cues.en: We're building to that.
cues.zh: 正在逐步接近。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So what you see now is little arrows over each box.
cues.zh: 現在看到，每一格上方都有小箭頭。

cues.en: Now the arrows are completely redundant with the color.
cues.zh: 箭頭與顏色的資訊完全重複。

cues.en: So if we look here, when the arrows or when the color is blue, meaning a negative partial derivative, then the arrow points to the left.
cues.zh: 例如這裡，顏色為藍色，表示偏導數為負時，箭頭指向左邊。

cues.en: And when the color is yellow, meaning a positive partial derivative, then the arrow points to the right.
cues.zh: 顏色為黃色，表示偏導數為正時，箭頭指向右邊。

cues.en: Furthermore, the larger the derivative in terms of magnitude, the longer this line.
cues.zh: 此外，導數的量值越大，這條線就越長。

cues.en: So out here the derivative is so small, the derivative is so close to zero that the line doesn't even get drawn, it just gets alias out.
cues.zh: 外面這裡的導數很小、非常接近零，所以線甚至沒有畫出來，在顯示解析度下消失了。

cues.en: Okay, so this is partial X here we have the same story for partial Y.
cues.zh: 好，這是對 x 的偏導數；對 y 也有相同情況。

cues.en: Again, the color and the arrows are redundant.
cues.zh: 同樣地，顏色與箭頭重複。

cues.en: They show exactly the same information.
cues.zh: 展示完全相同的資訊。

cues.en: It's just a different way of representing the partial derivatives.
cues.zh: 只是另一種偏導數的表示方式。

cues.en: Okay, so here are those same two images.
cues.zh: 好，這是同樣兩張影像。

cues.en: I've just moved them up here.
cues.zh: 只是移到上面。

cues.en: Now, the thing is that if we want to combine the information from these two partial derivatives, we cannot just do that using the color.
cues.zh: 現在，如果想結合兩個偏導數的資訊，不能只用顏色。

cues.en: You cannot combine the colors here and here because they mean different things.
cues.zh: 不能把這裡與那裡的顏色直接混合，因為意義不同。

cues.en: They correspond to the derivatives along different directions in the function.
cues.zh: 它們分別對應函數沿不同方向的導數。

cues.en: But you can combine the arrows from partial X and partial Y, and that is the way to visualize the gradient.
cues.zh: 但可以結合對 x 與對 y 的偏導數箭頭，這就是梯度的視覺化方式。

cues.en: And that is what you see here.
cues.zh: 這裡看到的就是。

cues.en: So now the color shows the function, not the partial derivatives, but the original function.
cues.zh: 現在，顏色顯示原函數，不是偏導數，而是原本的函數。

cues.en: And so the arrows have length and direction.
cues.zh: 箭頭則有長度與方向。

cues.en: And the direction shows the combination of the two partial derivatives and the length shows the magnitude of that derivative, which is also a combination of the two partial derivatives.
cues.zh: 方向顯示兩個偏導數的組合，長度顯示導數的量值，也來自兩個偏導數的組合。

cues.en: So pretty cool, isn't it?
cues.zh: 很酷，對吧？

cues.en: Basically, these arrows point upwards in the function, so they tell you how to climb up the function to higher values.
cues.zh: 基本上，這些箭頭指向函數的上坡方向，告訴你如何沿函數往更高的值爬。

cues.en: And that's why the arrows are popping out from this blue area where the function is negative and the arrows are pointing into the yellow area here where the function is more positive.
cues.zh: 所以，箭頭從函數為負的藍色區域往外，指進這裡函數比較正的黃色區域。

cues.en: So in other words, the gradient tells you the direction of the steepest increase in the function and in most functions.
cues.zh: 換句話說，梯度告訴你，函數增加最快的方向。而在大多數函數，

cues.en: And for most regions that direction is not exactly X and it's not.
cues.zh: 大多數區域，那個方向不會恰好是 x，也不會

cues.en: Actually why it's some combination of X and Y, and this is what I meant by the local landscape.
cues.zh: 恰好是 y，而是 x 與 y 的某種組合。這就是我所謂的局部地形。

cues.en: So the gradient at this point here doesn't tell you anything about the gradient elsewhere and all these other pixels here, it only tells you about the local gradient.
cues.zh: 這一點的梯度，並不告訴你其他地方、其他像素的梯度，只告訴你局部梯度，

cues.en: Exactly at this point.
cues.zh: 恰好在這一點。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: One final remark In the true abstract theoretical mathematical world, this function has an infinite
cues.zh: 最後提醒，在真正抽象、理論的數學世界裡，這個函數有無限

cues.en: number of points, which means there is also an infinite number of arrows.
cues.zh: 多個點，所以也有無限多個箭頭。

cues.en: Obviously, we cannot visualize that even using a much higher resolution to make the image smoother,
cues.zh: 顯然無法視覺化。即使用更高解析度，讓影像更平滑，

cues.en: that's going to give us so many arrows that it just gets really complicated and difficult to interpret.
cues.zh: 也會有太多箭頭，變得非常複雜，難以解讀。

cues.en: So it's pretty common to use a sparse grid sampling when visualizing the gradient fields.
cues.zh: 因此，畫梯度場時，經常使用較稀疏的網格取樣。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then that's what this map is called.
cues.zh: 而這張圖的名稱就是，

cues.en: This is the gradient field or the vector field or the gradient vector field.
cues.zh: 梯度場、向量場，或梯度向量場。

cues.en: It's the map of all these arrows here.
cues.zh: 就是這張箭頭分布圖。

cues.en: So now you know about gradients and visualizing them in vector fields.
cues.zh: 現在你認識了梯度，也知道如何用向量場視覺化。

cues.en: And again, gradients are really just a compact way of storing all of the partial derivatives.
cues.zh: 再說一次，梯度只是精簡儲存所有偏導數的方式。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So in this video, I presented the theory.
cues.zh: 這支影片介紹理論。

cues.en: In the next video, you will see how to create and work with gradients in Python.
cues.zh: 下一支影片，你會看到如何在 Python 建立並使用梯度。

cues.en: And then after that you will see an application of gradients in multivariate optimization.
cues.zh: 之後，會看到梯度在多變數最佳化中的應用。
